definitions.explanation: Individual parts used in electronic circuits and devices, such as resistors, capacitors, transistors, and integrated circuits. A key term in Japan's electronics manufacturing industry.

examples.japanese: {電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}が{不足|ふそく}している。
examples.english: There is a shortage of electronic components.

examples.japanese: この{工場|こうじょう}では{電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}を{年間|ねんかん}{百万|ひゃくまん}{個|こ}{生産|せいさん}している。
examples.english: This factory produces one million electronic components per year.

examples.japanese: {半導体|はんどうたい}をはじめとする{電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}の{供給|きょうきゅう}{不足|ふそく}が、{世界中|せかいじゅう}の{製造業|せいぞうぎょう}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えた。
examples.english: The supply shortage of electronic components, especially semiconductors, affected manufacturing worldwide.

notes:
A compound of {電子|でんし} (electronic) and {部品|ぶひん} (parts, components). Japan has been a major global producer and exporter of electronic components, and this term appears frequently in business news, particularly during supply chain disruptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}メーカー: electronic component manufacturer
- {電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}の{供給|きょうきゅう}: supply of electronic components
- {電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}の{調達|ちょうたつ}: procurement of electronic components
- {電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん}を{実装|じっそう}する: to mount electronic components (on a board)

EXAMPLES OF ELECTRONIC COMPONENTS:
- {抵抗器|ていこうき}: resistor
- コンデンサー: capacitor
- トランジスタ: transistor
- {集積回路|しゅうせきかいろ}(IC): integrated circuit
- ダイオード: diode

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {半導体|はんどうたい}: semiconductor — a specific type of electronic component/material
- {部品|ぶひん}: part, component — the general term for any machine part
- {電子|でんし}{機器|きき}: electronic device/equipment — the finished product rather than components
